⚠️ Penalty Rules
1. Late payment of maintenance: a penalty of 10% per month applies after the due date.
2. Due date: the 10th of every month.
3. Penalty structure:
  • 11th – 20th: 10% penalty on the maintenance amount.
  • 21st – 30th: penalty continues + services will be stopped to the flat.
  • If the owner does not respond, a penalty notice is sent and also physically posted on the flat's main door and on the notice board.

🔁 Guided Monthly Reminder Round

Walks you through every pending flat, one at a time, with WhatsApp or SMS pre-filled \u2014 you just tap Send each time. This is the fastest way possible from a phone; no app can send WhatsApp/SMS without you tapping Send at least once per person, that's a security rule on WhatsApp/SMS's side.

📲 Send Payment Reminders

Tapping a button opens your phone's Messaging app with the number & message pre-filled — review and press Send. (Auto-scheduled SMS needs a paid SMS gateway + server.)

WhatsApp can't message many numbers at once — this opens WhatsApp so you pick your society group and send the reminder to everyone in one message. For individuals, use the WhatsApp button on each flat below.

👆 Face / Fingerprint Unlock

    
Skip typing your password on this device — uses your phone's built-in Face ID / Fingerprint sensor. This is set up separately on each device and each board role.

    

  

  

    
⚙️ Configuration

    

  

  

    
🗑️ Remove Accidental Month Entry

    
Use this only to remove a month that was opened by mistake (e.g. a future month with no payments recorded). Months that already have paid flats or expenses will ask for extra confirmation before deleting.

    

    
  

  

    
🛠️ Fix Historical Months

    
If real payment tracking in this app only started partway through, older months will wrongly show every flat as unpaid — even if everyone actually paid. Use this to correct that in one step. This updates the Defaulters report, Balance Sheet, Annual Report, and Carry Forward Balance all at once.

Fixed monthly bills you always pay — the app will remind you to add them if they're missing from the current month.

    

    

      
      
    

    
  

  

    
⚠️ Penalty Rules

    

      1. Late payment of maintenance: a penalty of 10% per month applies after the due date.

      2. Due date: the 10th of every month.

      3. Penalty structure:
      
    
        
  • 11th – 20th: 10% penalty on the maintenance amount.
    • 
        
  • 21st – 30th: penalty continues + services will be stopped to the flat.
    • 
        
  • If the owner does not respond, a penalty notice is sent and also physically posted on the flat's main door and on the notice board.

📊 Import History from Excel

    
One-time import of the monthly maintenance sheets (Oct 2024 – May 2026): who paid, the real amount of each month, and the expenses. Months that already have data in the app are never changed. Super Admin only.

🔐 Approvals & OTP

    
Board password resets are authorised by a 6-digit OTP sent to the Vice President's mobile. Set that number here. Payments now use dual approval (Gen. Secretary + Secretary) and Treasurer confirmation — no OTP.

🔔 Update Alerts 

    
When the board records a payment, expense, meeting or notice, an update is posted to Notices for every member, and a red badge shows how many are unread.

    

    

      
      
    

  



    
🔊 Voice Due Reminder 

    
From the 5th to the 10th each month, the app speaks the pending-maintenance reminder aloud when opened. It stops automatically once payment is marked received.

    

      
      
    

    

      
      
    

    
Note: Hindi/Telugu speech depends on the voices installed on each phone; if unavailable it reads in English.

  



    
💾 Backup & Restore (important)

    

      
☁️ Cloud Sync ☁️ live sync on

      
Changes now sync automatically to everyone. The buttons below are only for manual backup/restore if ever needed.

      
      
      

    

    
All data is stored only on this phone. Download a backup regularly and keep it safe — email it to yourself or save it to Google Drive. If this phone is lost, reset, or the app data is cleared, you can restore everything from a backup file.

    
    
    
    
    
Restore replaces everything. Merge only adds records that are missing — nothing already here is deleted or changed.

    
Tip: download a fresh backup after every month's entries.

    

      
☁️ Automatic Cloud Backups

      
If the daily backup Cloud Function is deployed, a snapshot is saved automatically every night — no one needs to remember to click anything. Fetch the most recent one here anytime.

      

        
        
      

      

    

    

      
      

        
        
      

      
      
Opens your phone's share sheet with the backup file attached — pick Gmail and send. This one file holds all data and every uploaded bill/document. (Sending must be done by you each time — it can't send on its own.)
